name: react-hot-loader
description: Tweak React components in real time. (Deprecated: use Fast Refresh instead.)

commits.message: Remove space after peerDependency version definition (#1843)
Note create-react-app support for fast refresh in readme (#1708)
fix: tailUpdate might be blocked by a PureComponent (#1448)
README: Link to Fast Refresh Webpack plugin
Discourage using webpack loader for all the files (#1452)
fix: when module.hot is not truthy (#1451)
Fix link to issue 1001 in readme (#1415)
add inner hook to the SC example
fix: don't record signatures of local hooks, fixes #1412 (#1413)
Update redux example and remove some file (#1404)
more rich test scenario fro hooks reload
fix: production babel plugin might perform eager replacement, fixes #1388
fix: (regression) hook order change is causing React error, fixes #1393
fix: move @types/react from to peer dependencies, fixes #1391
fix: explain why RHL could not be activated, fixes #1362
fix: dont write to elementType if it is not defined, fixes #1357
fix: use logger.warn instead of console to report tail update, fixes #1386
chore(deps): bump safer-eval from 1.2.3 to 1.3.5 in /examples/parcel
Update troubleshooting doc with new tip
Update lint-staged to fix dozens of vulnerabilities
Update some dev-deps to fix some critical vulnerabilities
alter tail update message and configuration
add options to control tail updates
fix: autodetect underupdated state and trigger an automatic update, fixes #1342
fix: resolve all components to their last versions, #1342
